about: VST parameter -> FM8E payload field plus measured transfer function. Validated by reconstructing stored bytes at nine sweep points (0..1 in eighths) and re-checked out of sample at v=0.9. Measurements only; no Native Instruments code or data.

validation.in_sample: 9/9 sweep points reconstructed for every entry

encodings.f32: LE float32, value = a + b*v, rounded when quantised
encodings.uN: LE integer of N*8 bits, round(a + b*v) mod 2^N (wraps when a signed field crosses the modulus)
encodings.enumN: N distinct stored byte values; see values
